title: US, China trade teams set to huddle in New York on AI, Iran
description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng are set to hold trade talks in New York on Sunday ahead of the September 24 meeting between US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping.
